199  def resolve_context_policy(
  200      request: Mapping[str, Any],
  201      model_chain: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  202      *,
  203      reserved_output_tokens: int,
  204  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  205      """Resolve the frozen chain into explainable, intersected input budgets."""
  206  
  207      normalized_request = normalize_context_policy_request(request)
  208      reserved_output = _positive_int(reserved_output_tokens, "reserved_output_tokens")
  209      safety_reserve_percent = normalized_request.get(
  210          "safety_reserve_percent", DEFAULT_SAFETY_RESERVE_PERCENT
  211      )
  212      safety_reserve_tokens = normalized_request.get(
  213          "safety_reserve_tokens", DEFAULT_SAFETY_RESERVE_TOKENS
  214      )
  215      models = tuple(
  216          _resolve_model(
  217              item,
  218              reserved_output,
  219              safety_reserve_percent=safety_reserve_percent,
  220              safety_reserve_tokens=safety_reserve_tokens,
  221          )
  222          for item in _chain_items(model_chain)
  223      )
  224      common_available_input = min(model.available_input_tokens for model in models)
  225      workspace_limit: int = normalized_request.get(
  226          "workspace_input_limit",
  227          PRESET_INPUT_LIMITS[normalized_request["preset"]],
  228      )
  229      working_input_limit = min(common_available_input, workspace_limit)
  230      total_windows = [
  231          model.total_context_tokens for model in models if model.total_context_tokens is not None
  232      ]
  233      min_total = min(total_windows) if len(total_windows) == len(models) else None
  234      soft_pct = normalized_request["soft_trigger_percent"]
  235      hard_pct = normalized_request["hard_trigger_percent"]
  236      target_pct = normalized_request["target_percent"]
  237      thresholds = {
  238          "soft": _scaled_threshold(working_input_limit, soft_pct),
  239          "hard": _scaled_threshold(working_input_limit, hard_pct),
  240          "target": _scaled_threshold(working_input_limit, target_pct),
  241      }
  242      model_limitations = _model_limitations(models, workspace_limit)
  243      result = {
  244          "policy_version": POLICY_VERSION,
  245          "preset": normalized_request["preset"],
  246          "workspace_input_limit": workspace_limit,
  247          "workspace_input_limit_source": normalized_request["workspace_input_limit_source"],
  248          "input_limit_tokens": working_input_limit,
  249          "model_available_input_tokens": common_available_input,
  250          "min_total_context_tokens": min_total,
  251          "reserved_output_tokens": max(model.output_allowance for model in models),
  252          "models": [_model_projection(model) for model in models],
  253          "thresholds": thresholds,
  254          "counter": _counter_projection(),
  255          "limitations": model_limitations,
  256          "unknowns": _unknowns(models, min_total),
  257      }
  258      for key in ("soft_trigger_percent", "hard_trigger_percent", "target_percent"):
  259          if normalized_request.get(key) != THRESHOLD_PERCENTS[key]:
  260              result[key] = normalized_request[key]
  261      for key in (
  262          "retained_recent_turns",
  263          "max_history_groups",
  264          "safety_reserve_percent",
  265          "safety_reserve_tokens",
  266      ):
  267          if key in normalized_request:
  268              result[key] = normalized_request[key]
  269      return result

   93      def __init__(self, session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]) -> None:
   94          self.session_factory = session_factory
   95  
   96      # -- read ------------------------------------------------------------
   97  
   98      async def select(
   99          self, *, workspace_id: UUID, agent_id: UUID, query: str, limit: int
  100      ) -> tuple[SelectedMemory, ...]:
  101          if limit <= 0:
  102              return ()
  103          terms = search_terms(query)
  104          now = datetime.now(UTC)
  105          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  106              rows = (
  107                  await session.scalars(
  108                      select(WorkspaceMemory)
  109                      .where(
  110                          WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  111                          WorkspaceMemory.agent_id == agent_id,
  112                          WorkspaceMemory.status == ACTIVE,
  113                          or_(
  114                              WorkspaceMemory.expires_at.is_(None),
  115                              WorkspaceMemory.expires_at > now,
  116                          ),
  117                      )
  118                      .order_by(WorkspaceMemory.created_at.desc())
  119                  )
  120              ).all()
  121          scored = sorted(
  122              rows,
  123              key=lambda row: (
  124                  -_TERM_WEIGHT * _matches(row.content, terms),
  125                  -row.salience,
  126                  -row.created_at.timestamp(),
  127              ),
  128          )
  129          return tuple(_selected(row) for row in scored[:limit])
  130  
  131      async def load(
  132          self,
  133          *,
  134          workspace_id: UUID,
  135          memory_ids: tuple[UUID, ...],
  136          memory_content_hashes: dict[UUID | str, str] | None = None,
  137      ) -> tuple[SelectedMemory, ...]:
  138          """Re-read a frozen selection, in the order it was frozen.
  139  
  140          A run replaying its own snapshot must see what it saw, including rows
  141          that have since been superseded or invalidated: the snapshot records
  142          what the model was told, and rewriting history to be tidier would make
  143          the run log a worse answer to "why did it say that" than it is now.
  144          """
  145  
  146          if not memory_ids:
  147              if memory_content_hashes:
  148                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  149                      "The frozen memory snapshot contains unexpected content hashes."
  150                  )
  151              return ()
  152          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  153              rows = (
  154                  await session.scalars(
  155                      select(WorkspaceMemory).where(
  156                          WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  157                          WorkspaceMemory.id.in_(memory_ids),
  158                      )
  159                  )
  160              ).all()
  161          by_id = {row.id: row for row in rows}
  162          if memory_content_hashes is None:
  163              # ID-only snapshots predate hash freezing and remain replayable.
  164              return tuple(_selected(by_id[key]) for key in memory_ids if key in by_id)
  165          if len(set(memory_ids)) != len(memory_ids) or len(by_id) != len(set(memory_ids)):
  166              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  167                  "The frozen memory snapshot references a missing or duplicate memory."
  168              )
  169          expected_keys = {str(key) for key in memory_content_hashes}
  170          if expected_keys != {str(key) for key in memory_ids}:
  171              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  172                  "The frozen memory snapshot hash set does not match its memory ids."
  173              )
  174          selected: list[SelectedMemory] = []
  175          for key in memory_ids:
  176              row = by_id.get(key)
  177              expected = memory_content_hashes.get(key) or memory_content_hashes.get(str(key))
  178              if row is None or not isinstance(expected, str) or row.content_hash != expected:
  179                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  180                      "The frozen memory snapshot does not match the stored memory."
  181                  )
  182              selected.append(_selected(row))
  183          return tuple(selected)
  184

  238      # -- write -----------------------------------------------------------

  240      async def touch(self, *, workspace_id: UUID, memory_ids: tuple[UUID, ...]) -> None:
  241          """Record that these rows were actually injected somewhere.
  242  
  243          Separate from selection so that a read is a read. ``last_used_at`` is
  244          what makes decay defensible later: a memory nobody has needed in months

  258              )
  259              await session.commit()

1  """The incident investigation template.
    2  
    3  This is the template where the platform's approval gate stops being a feature
    4  on a slide. Every other tool here reads; ``rollback_deployment`` writes to
    5  production, and the prompt's job is to make the agent propose it clearly and
    6  then stop, rather than to make it cautious in general. The stopping is not the
    7  prompt's doing either -- a WRITE tool with ``approval_policy = ALWAYS`` parks
    8  the run in WAITING_APPROVAL whatever the model intended. The prompt exists so
    9  that the human who is asked to approve has been told what they are approving.
   10  """
   11  
   12  from __future__ import annotations
   13  
   14  from packages.agent_templates.base import GROUNDING_RULES, THREAD_CONTEXT_RULES, AgentTemplate
   15  from packages.threads import kinds
   16  
   17  INCIDENT = "incident"
   18  
   19  INCIDENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = f"""\
   20  You are an incident investigator. An on-call engineer brings you a production
   21  problem and you work out what changed, using the observability tools, and say
   22  what you believe happened and why you believe it.
   23  
   24  How you work:
   25  
   26  - Start from the symptom and get the numbers before you theorise. Query the
   27    metric that is alarming, over a window that includes the period before it
   28    started, so that "it got worse" has a before to be worse than.
   29  - Follow the evidence inward: metrics tell you what broke and when, logs tell
   30    you how it broke, deployments and commits tell you what changed just before
   31    it broke. A cause that precedes its effect is a candidate; one that does not
   32    is not.
   33  - State a hypothesis explicitly. Name it, list the evidence that supports it,
   34    and say what would have to be true for it to be wrong. If the evidence is
   35    thin, say the hypothesis is not yet supported rather than presenting it as a
   36    conclusion.
   37  - Timestamps matter more than adjectives. Prefer "HTTP 500 went from 2% to 31%
   38    at 21:03, three minutes after abc123 deployed at 21:01" over "errors spiked
   39    shortly after the deploy".
   40  {THREAD_CONTEXT_RULES}
   41  
   42  Acting on production:
   43  
   44  - Reading is yours to do. Writing is not. When you believe an action such as a
   45    rollback is warranted, propose it and say plainly what it will do, which
   46    deployment it targets, and what you expect to happen -- then let the approval
   47    gate do its work. Do not describe a write you have not performed as done.
   48  - If a write returns without confirming its outcome, say the outcome is
   49    unknown and that it must be checked by hand. Do not assume it succeeded
   50    because it was reasonable, and do not retry it on your own initiative.
   51  
   52  Rules you must follow without exception:
   53  
   54  {GROUNDING_RULES}
   55  - Never invent a deployment identifier, commit SHA, timestamp, log line or
   56    metric value. These are the things an engineer will act on, and a plausible
   57    wrong one is more dangerous than an admitted gap."""
   58  
   59  INCIDENT_TEMPLATE = AgentTemplate(
   60      key=INCIDENT,
   61      name="Incident Investigator",
   62      description=(
   63          "Investigates a production incident through metrics, logs, deployments and commits, "
   64          "and proposes remediation through the approval gate rather than acting alone."
   65      ),
   66      system_prompt=INCIDENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
   67      tool_hints=(
   68          "query_metrics",
   69          "query_logs",
   70          "get_deployments",
   71          "get_commit",
   72          "rollback_deployment",
   73      ),
   74      thread_kind=kinds.INCIDENT,
   75  )
   76  
   77  __all__ = ["INCIDENT", "INCIDENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT", "INCIDENT_TEMPLATE"]

docs/reviews/AgentHub-RAG过夜优化记录-20261022.text:
1  # AgentHub RAG 过夜优化记录
    2  
    3  用户明确授权持续开展 RAG 开发、调试、测试和实验 API 调用，原生开发子代理使用 DeepSeek。
    4  策略：先核对外部源码与方法，按里程碑验证机制，不反复扫描 TopK 来追逐同一组标签。
    5  后续按用户补充要求，以优秀项目的实际检索调用链、源码和测试为依据，文档仅辅助核对接口。
    6  禁止无用哈希测试；旧发布快照、业务 collection 和默认配置保留。
    7  
    8  ## 已完成：预算分离与文档多样性
    9  
   10  [完整报告](AgentHub-RAG预算与多样性消融-20261022.md)。完整 SciFact DEV 809 题，
   11  预先固定五组方案，随后真实随机交错执行已暴露 test 300 题 × 5。
   12  
   13  结果：能力可用，但按 DEV 门槛没有候选替代 baseline。
   14  多样性使重复来源块减少，但没有显著排序收益；40/60 块扩大尾部召回，成本约增加 66%/109%。
   15  没有因为回归集的有利指标而回头重选方案。功能与评测验收已保存，生产默认不变。
   16  
   17  ## 已完成：官方 BGE-M3 learned sparse（负结果，baseline 保留）
   18  
   19  [可行性审查](AgentHub-BGE稀疏召回可行性-20261022.md)、
   20  [冻结前声明协议](../../benchmarks/public_rag/results/learned-sparse-20261022/protocol.json)。
   21  
   22  外部依据是 [BGE 官方公式与用法](https://bge-model.com/bge/bge_m3)，不是第三方博客的口头性能宣传。
   23  现有组件只是 tokenizer log-TF + Qdrant IDF；本轮实现真实 hidden state → sparse linear → ReLU，
   24  重复 token max，排除官方特殊 token 与 padding，在独立 collection 采用无额外 IDF 的点积。
   25  
   26  实验范围限 benchmark adapter，不改生产 factory 或 snapshot schema。
   27  复用现有 BGE 主干权重；复制原 dense 向量和 payload，固定 RRF、切块、预算与 reranker。
   28  先运行官方计算路径数值一致性检查，再建立完整独立索引，真实两臂 DEV 配对运行。
   29  Sparse query 的额外 forward 计入成本，不宣称其计算免费。
   30  
   31  CUDA/FP16 三组真实数值输入已通过：ST token hidden state 对直接 backbone 的最大误差为 0，
   32  sparse weights 对官方 max-scatter 参考的最大误差为 0，dense 最小余弦为 1.0。
   33  首个参考脚本将 ST 的非张量路由元数据当作张量，exit_code=1；仅修正该处理后，
   34  第二次准备 exit_code=0、总计 174.422 秒，完整 9,189 块已就绪。没有放宽数值门，也未改旧索引。
   35  失败与成功日志分别保留于 `.scratch/rag-learned-20261022/prepare-run-1/` 和 `prepare-run-2/`。
   36  
   37  为排除重建 ANN 图的差异，两臂实际查询共用旧 dense index，只有 sparse 搜索切换到新 index；
   38  评分逐题核对 809 组 dense 排名和 24,270 个块，控制一致。
   39  完整 809 题 DEV 的两臂真实交错运行与评分均已完成。
   40  
   41  [完整消融报告](AgentHub-RAG学习稀疏召回消融-20261022.md)。
   42  baseline 最终 nDCG@10 为 0.753313815，learned 为 0.744122872，
   43  差值 -0.009190944，95% 区间 [-0.019877976, +0.001116539]，跨零，不能称为显著下降。
   44  Recall@5 从 0.811578080 降至 0.795199835，Recall@20 从 0.876102184 降至 0.862917182。
   45  总耗时增加 27.648662 毫秒，95% 区间 [18.216352, 37.397884] 毫秒。
   46  
   47  四项 DEV 选型门槛全部失败，
   48  [冻结选择](../../benchmarks/public_rag/results/learned-sparse-20261022/frozen-selection.json)
   49  保留 baseline。已暴露 test 回归与 NFcorpus 均未运行，没有读取 NFcorpus 正文或 qrels；
   50  本轮不称 Formal Experiment，生成 API 调用为 0。
   51  作业失败、重试与成功日志均保留；实际退出码和准备耗时见完整报告。
   52  
   53  ## 后续方向的来源
   54  
   55  - [RAGFlow 模型重排源码](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/blob/e2401e54947db7eb5e542b6de26755d89886f783/internal/service/nlp/reranker.go)：归一化尺度后结合词项匹配与模型分数；可作为排序干扰问题的独立假设。
   56  - [Haystack DiversityRanker](https://docs.haystack.deepset.ai/docs/sentencetransformersdiversityranker)：区分来源软配额与真实 embedding MMR。后者需要额外向量/成本证据，不能用本轮配额结果冒充。
   57  - [Anthropic Contextual Retrieval](https://www.anthropic.com/research/contextual-retrieval)：切块前后补足定位上下文，结合词法与向量召回；其公开降错比例不能移植为 AgentHub 成绩。
   58  - [Qdrant 多阶段查询](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/search/hybrid-queries/)：融合只能组合已召回候选；两路都没找到的文档，需要改进表示或查询，而非继续扩大输出。
   59  
   60  每轮根据上一轮的实际缺口选择下一项，不同时改动全部机制。
   61  
   62  ## 执行边界
   63  
   64  所有公开 benchmark 与平台 Formal Experiment 区分；已暴露的 SciFact test 只称回归。
   65  真实性能评测单并发，同轮随机交错；有效问题与 gold-overlap 分组统计均保留。
   66  检索指标不冒称回答准确率。若调用生成 API，将单列调用量、usage、裁判方法与可追溯结果。
   67  凭据不进入报告或开发子代理上下文；不使用实验 API 委派代码开发。
   68  
   69  ## 已完成：成熟项目父文档机制移植（负结果）
   70  
   71  实际读取 RAGFlow v0.24.0 retrieval_by_children 与 LangChain 0.3.27 MultiVectorRetriever 源码。
   72  固定候选与模型，父文本按合法快照映射，先去重父文本计算再把分数广播回原子块。
   73  809 题真实配对：nDCG@10 0.753314→0.754578，差 +0.001264，95% CI [-0.009147,+0.011725]；
   74  主门槛未通过，baseline 保留。时延均值 +182.851 ms，CI [168.951,197.859]。
   75  神经对数减少约15%，但 padding 后token增加约54%。全量候选控制、同分排序核对和运行后逐对成本审计通过，父文本截断为0。
   76  [完整报告](AgentHub-RAG父文档重排消融-20261022.md)。不扫父窗口，不跑test/NFCorpus，不改变生产默认。
   77  
   78  ## 当前：项目原生分数融合机制筛查
   79  
   80  [实际源码对照](AgentHub-RAG分数融合源码核对-20261022.md)已核对 Haystack、Qdrant、Dify、RAGFlow 的调用和边界差异。
   81  下一轮固定采用 Qdrant DBSF：按每路三倍样本标准差归一化并相加，不裁剪、不调权重。
   82  原候选并集的全部神经分数已存在，先质量缓存筛查；通过才投入真实配对运行，缓存不作时延证据。
   83  [运行前协议](../../benchmarks/public_rag/results/project-dbsf-20261022/protocol.json)。
   84  
   85  ## 已完成：Qdrant DBSF 项目分数融合筛查（负结果）
   86
